comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of the peptide shows 95% similarity to Chicken LEAP-2, only differing at two residues. The propsoed 2 S-S bonds are C17-C28, C23-C33. Activity: Active against S. aureus, E. coli (90% killing at 50 ug/mL), and L. monocytogenes by membrane permeation. more active against Gram+. 7/2021
reference_text: Asian-Australas J Anim Sci. 2018 Oct 29. doi: 10.5713/ajas.18.0571. PubMed
title: Identification of duck liver-expressed antimicrobial peptide 2 (LEAP-2) and characterization of its bactericidal activity
